label: Post-discovery business readiness architecture
principle: Useful actions come after truthful Earth discovery; commercial relationships never choose or rank Earth windows.

actionOrder.purpose: Open or play the truthful current Earth window
Explore related and nearby places using editorial/currentness rules
Use current visual context and destination information to decide whether the place is relevant
Optionally expose verified planning actions such as activities, tickets or stays only after destination selection

smallBusinessPrinciples: Prefer a few verified useful actions over broad inventory
Do not require accounts for basic discovery
Do not add operational complexity without demonstrated visitor value
